en: Vintage monochrome postcard view of a town square. On the left is a long row of two‑storey houses with pitched roofs and trees or vines trained along their facades; several people stand in the open square in front. On the right edge is part of a large historic building with a stepped gable partly obscured by tall trees. The image has light age spots. Printed in red at the bottom are the words "Mühlberg a. Elbe" and "Neustädter Markt", with a small number "4456" in the lower left corner.
